data.standardized_narrative: During 2020 the Syndicate strengthened prior year reserves, with an adverse prior-year movement (deterioration) of approximately $53.0m. The strengthening primarily arose from an extensive review of old case files and a series of adverse US court rulings, particularly affecting long-tail professional and financial institutions liability classes. COVID-19 and 2020 natural catastrophe activity (notably US hurricanes Laura and Delta) also impacted results, though the $53m prior-year deterioration is principally attributable to the reserve review and legal developments.

an extensive review of old case files by the newly strengthened team of in-house claims experts, and a series of unexpected adverse US court rulings, contributed a further $53m of losses

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was found. The report contains an explicit net deterioration of $53,039,944 in the net provision for claims; this net figure has been used for prior_year_development_gbp_m (not ideal - gross not available). A gross claims development triangle is present but complex to map precisely; a best-effort gross triangle extraction is included and should be treated as approximate. All monetary amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD). Mapping of specific internal classes to Lloyd's standard LOBs (e.g. 'Professional Indemnity' -> 'Professional Lines') is approximate.
